scope.pathAwareWrites: compared with optional PRE_CHANGE literal prefixes for drift evidence

verification.compoundShellCommands: never accepted as automatic verification evidence

verification.completionBinding: optional verifier evidence is bound to reviewRevision and verificationRevision
